About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Agentic payments is a team that’s building new APIs and integration experiences for agentic commerce online. We think that the proliferation of consumer-facing AI experiences will unlock new ways that consumers buy things online, and our existing payments experiences need to evolve to new commercial models that cutting-edge builders are starting. Our first launch, Instant Checkout in collaboration with OpenAI, took the industry by storm and we’re bringing experiences like that to the entire universe of AI agents and sellers.

What you’ll do

As an Engineering Manager on Agentic Commerce, you’ll own the shaping and delivery of transformative products that redefine how commerce works, making it more fluid, automated, and aligned with user intent. You’ll collaborate closely with product management, design, data science, and marketing to unlock new opportunities for our customers and partners globally.

Our north star provides a new integration model for AI agents who are looking to build agent-powered online commerce experiences, via their Stripe integration. They will have access to our entire suite of connected sellers, and can focus on the end-user experience. Enabling an AI agent to do this requires new API primitives, new dashboard surfaces, and deep thought about what financial and e-commerce complexity Stripe can simplify on their behalf. 

Responsibilities.

  • Build full stack solutions across Stripe's ecosystem, including back end services, dashboard interfaces, money movement systems, and integrations with other Stripe primitives
  • Partner deeply with product management and design to ship high impact features that increase user autonomy and reduce friction.
  • Apply strong analytical skills to dive into data, test hypotheses, and make informed trade-offs. Set success metrics for the team to ensure solutions are enterprise-grade and quickly meet Stripe’s reliability SLOs.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally across Stripe’s broader platform and product teams to integrate agentic commerce capabilities seamlessly.
  • Engage directly with users (particularly large enterprises) to understand their business needs and translate requirements into novel product shapes.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of engineering experience with a computer science background with hands on development expertise
  • AI-native and very comfortable autonomously solving problems with agentic AI tools
  • Proven experience coaching and developing senior and staff level individual contributors
  • Demonstrated experience of leading initiatives that touch large engineering organizations, spanning multiple teams to influence tech roadmap planning and execution
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, structuring ambiguous concepts clearly and from first principles
  • Thrive in a collaborative environment involving different functions, stakeholders, and subject matter experts
  • Deep empathy for users balancing autonomy and guidance in digital commerce experiences.

Preferred qualifications

  • 5+ years of engineering management experience
  • Experience building APIs or new integration experiences for users, several of them being enterprise grade
  • You’ve been on the founding team of a business / startup, taking a product from 0-1
  • Experience in eCommerce and/or payments.

Timely and predictable delivery of product. This is the mandate everything else serves. When BitGo says something ships, it ships.

Run the programs where product delivery and control exposure intersect: new-product regulatory review pipelines with fixed examiner deadlines, remediation of audit findings where the fix is a product build, and delivery against commitments made to regulators. The Role

We are looking for a Director, Sales Compensation Operations to own the end-to-end operational engine behind how our go-to-market teams are credited, assigned quotas, and paid. This is a people-leadership role at the center of Sales, Finance, Revenue Operations, and Systems, where accuracy, timeliness, and trust are everything.

You will lead two core functions — crediting & quota operations and commission operations — ensuring every rep understands how they are measured and is paid correctly and on time.

You'll lead and grow a team of compensation operations professionals, setting the operating rhythm for how compensation runs at scale. You'll build repeatable processes and controls, drive automation where it improves accuracy and speed, and partner closely with senior Sales and Finance leadership to make sure our incentive programs are executed accurately. You will report to the Head of Revenue Strategy & Planning within the Revenue organization.

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team across business operations, crediting operations, data pipeline management, data quality and audit, process governance, and commission calculation. Set clear goals and operating cadences, invest in career growth, and get into the details when the work calls for it.
  • Oversee the end-to-end monthly and quarterly commission cycle, from crediting and quota data through calculation, validation, review, approval, and payout. Make sure comp plan policies are implemented accurately and every rep is paid correctly and on time.
  • Implement and operationalize the crediting rules and processes behind them. This includes quota issuance and rollup to leaders by role, executing credit rules, and processing mid-period adjustments across the go-to-market organization.
  • Own the data pipelines that move quota, crediting, and revenue data between systems such as Looker, Salesforce, and Pigment. Maintain the transformation logic that powers them, and research and resolve data issues when they arise.
  • Administer and improve our sales compensation tech stack: Pigment for ICM and quota issuance, and Salesforce as our system of record. Drive automation, data integrity, and scalability as the business grows.
  • Own data quality and audit for commissionable crediting data. Cure and reconcile source data before it feeds calculations. Maintain controls, documentation, and audit readiness.
  • Run process governance, exception review, and policy review. Handle edge cases at scale without creating a backlog. Identify what's breaking repeatedly and fix the root cause.
  • Partner with Sales Compensation Design, Quota Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Sales leadership. Translate plan design into execution, support the rollout and validation of new and updated plans, and bring operational feedback into future design decisions.
  • Deliver reporting and insights on payout accuracy, cycle times, exceptions, and other operational KPIs. Flag risks early and use data to prioritize improvements.
  • Enable frontline sales teams to understand their compensation structures and plans, including how they are credited, measured, and paid, to build trust and transparency in the incentive program.

  • 5+ years of people leadership experience, with a track record of building, coaching, and scaling high-performing operations teams.
  • Experience operating complex compensation environments across multiple sales motions, roles, and revenue models.
  • Expertise administering an ICM / sales compensation platform (Pigment strongly preferred; Xactly, CaptivateIQ, Anaplan, Varicent, or similar) and strong hands-on comfort with Salesforce as a source system.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI and automation tools to accelerate and improve the accuracy of calculation, reconciliation, reporting, and operational workflows.
  • Strong understanding of ETL pipelines and data flows between CRM, ICM, and financial systems.
  • Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills and comfort with SQL. Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.
  • Demonstrated ability to design and operate controls, documentation, and audit-ready processes.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience partnering with Sales, Finance, and Revenue Operations leadership.
  • Ability to operate autonomously in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift.

Bonus

  • Experience in payments, fintech, or a consumption-based business model.
  • Hands-on experience building or directly managing ETL pipelines between comp systems.
  • You've migrated or implemented a commissions platform before.

  • Own critical systems end to end, from architecture and technical design through development, launch, and iteration

  • Shape technical direction, making architectural decisions and helping establish engineering standards as Breeze scales

  • Experience with cryptocurrency or blockchain is a plus

We believe compensation should be fair, competitive, consistent, and transparent. We benchmark compensation against the market and establish thoughtful bands for each role, with compensation reflecting experience, skills, location, role scope, and expected impact. We don't believe pay should primarily depend on how aggressively someone negotiates. Eligible employees receive meaningful equity, so the people building Breeze can participate in the long-term value they help create.

Benefits & Perks

  • Medical allowance: An annual allowance, prorated based on your start date, to support eligible health and wellness expenses, including health screenings, dental and vision care, insurance premiums, and eligible expenses for direct family members.
  • Corporate medical insurance: Medical coverage for full-time employees in our Singapore office, including cashless GP visits at panel clinics, specialist outpatient care with GP referral, and teleconsultations.
  • Gym & wellness: A monthly subsidy toward eligible fitness and wellness memberships, classes, and activities.
  • Productivity budget: An annual budget, prorated based on your start date, for professional development, productivity tools, books, courses, and eligible home-office improvements.
  • Equity: Meaningful ownership in the company you're helping build.
  • Equipment: A new MacBook Air and whatever else you need to do your best work.
  • Annual global offsite: We bring the global Breeze team together every year. Previous destinations include Bali and Singapore, with Japan coming next.

Benefits, allowances, and reimbursements are subject to applicable eligibility requirements, taxes, and statutory contributions. Benefits are not contractual and may be amended from time to time.

  • Solve hard, meaningful problems: Work at the intersection of AI, payments, stablecoins, risk, compliance, financial infrastructure, and global commerce as we build an intelligent infrastructure layer that goes far beyond payments.
  • Build AI-first: AI isn't an add-on. It's central to how we're building our products and how our teams operate. You'll experiment with new tools, automate the repetitive, and continuously rethink how to work smarter.
  • Work with an exceptional team: Join ambitious, curious, low-ego people who move quickly, hold a high bar, and care deeply about what they build.
  • Grow with Breeze: As Breeze grows, strong performers can quickly expand their scope and take on bigger problems.
  • Build for the long term: Backed by Sequoia Capital, Multicoin Capital, and The Chainsmokers, we're exceptionally well-capitalized with the runway to think big.

In-Office Expectations

Employees based in our New York City, NY office follow a hybrid work model and are expected to work from the office three days per week. Employees based in our Singapore office are expected to work on-site five days per week.

In-office expectations may vary slightly depending on role, team, and business needs. Certain roles that require closer cross-functional collaboration or operational support may have additional requirements, which will be discussed during the interview process.

Our approach is designed to support meaningful in-person collaboration, team building, and real-time decision-making while providing flexibility where applicable. We believe this structure enables strong execution, close collaboration, and effective teamwork across our global offices.

Come Build With Us!

We offer a rare combination: the ownership and speed of an early-stage company with the traction, backing, and financial foundations of a successful business.

We're building at the convergence of AI, payments, stablecoins, financial infrastructure, and global commerce. The opportunity is much bigger than building another payment processor.

We're building the intelligent infrastructure layer for global commerce, and there's still an enormous amount left to build.

If you want meaningful ownership, hard problems, exceptional teammates, and the opportunity to help define what comes next, we'd love to hear from you!
